'''Alvin Gajadhur''' ({{IPA|pl|ɡaˈja.dur|lang}}; born 3 July 1973) is a Polish politician, civil servant, [[chemical engineering|chemical engineer]], and educator. From 2017 to 2024, he served as the Chief Inspector of Road Transport of Poland, and in 2023, he was the [[Ministry of Infrastructure (Poland)|Minister of Infrastructure]]. He is an [[Independent politician]], associated with the [[Law and Justice]] party.

== Early life and education ==
Alvin Gajadhur was born on 3 July 1973 in [[London]], England, as the son of [[Polish people|Polish]] mother, Zofia, and [[Indian people|Indian]] father, Anirood, and grew up in Poland.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://katalog.bip.ipn.gov.pl/informacje/693227|website=katalog.bip.ipn.gov.pl|language=pl|title=Dane osoby pełniącej funkcje publiczne|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231209132216/https://katalog.bip.ipn.gov.pl/informacje/693227|archive-date=2023-12-09}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://warszawa.wyborcza.pl/warszawa/7,34862,15645605,wojewodzki-i-figurski-przed-sadem-za-rasistowskie-zarty.html?disableRedirects=true|title=Wojewódzki i Figurski przed sądem za rasistowskie żarty.|language=pl|date=18 March 2014|website=warszawa.wyborcza.pl}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Będzie pozew wyborczy przeciwko Kubie Wojewódzkiemu i Michałowi Figurskiemu?|url=https://www.gazetaprawna.pl/wiadomosci/artykuly/554159,bedzie-pozew-wyborczy-przeciwko-kubie-wojewodzkiemu-i-michalowi-figurskiemu.html|website=gazetaprawna.pl|language=pl|date=6 October 2011}}</ref> He graduated from the St. Augustin General Education High School in Warsaw, and later, from the [[Warsaw University of Technology]] with degrees in [[chemical engineering]], and management and marketing.<ref name=wo>{{cite web|url=https://wiadomosci.onet.pl/autorzy/alvin-gajadhur|website=wiadomosci.onet.pl|title=Alvin Gajadhur, autor bloga 'My kierowcy'|language=pl|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231128084057/https://wiadomosci.onet.pl/autorzy/alvin-gajadhur|archive-date=2023-11-28}}</ref> In 2003, he received a title of a [[Habilitation|habilitated doctor]] in chemistry from the same university.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://archiwum.nauka-polska.pl/#/profile/scientist?id=121083|website=archiwum.nauka-polska.pl|title=Dr Alvin Gajadhur|language=pl}}</ref> He also completed the training for candidates for road transport inspectors.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.gitd.gov.pl/gitd/kierownictwo|website=gitd.gov.pl|language=pl|title=Kierownictwo|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170607133310/http://www.gitd.gov.pl/gitd/kierownictwo|archive-date=2017-06-07}}</ref>

== Career ==
Gajadhur has lectured on road transport, marketing, and public relations. From 2002 to 2016, he was the spokesperson for the Chief Inspector of Road Transport. From 2007 to 2012, he also served as a public relations advisor to the President of the Office of Rail Transport. In 2013, together with Mariusz Sokołowski and Klaudia Podkalicka, he co-hosted the [[TVP3 Warszawa]] educational programme ''Szkoła Przetrwania'', concerning the road safety, and also wrote a blog for the web portal [[Onet.pl]].<ref name=wo/><ref>{{cite web|url=https://satkurier.pl/news/84543/szkola-przetrwania-nowosc-w-tvp-warszawa.html|language=pl|title='Szkoła Przetrwania' - nowość w TVP Warszawa|date=9 April 2013|author=Łukasz Knapik|website=satkurier.pl}}</ref> He actively posts on social media, including on [[TikTok]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.fakt.pl/polityka/minister-z-tiktoka-co-pokazuje-na-swoich-filmikach/rf9cjgl|website=fakt.pl|language=pl|title=Nowy minister to gwiazdor social mediów. Lubi zdjęcia z krokodylem|date=28 November 2023}}</ref>

Gajadhur unsuccessfully ran in the [[2011 Polish parliamentary election|2011 parliamentary election]] for a seat in the [[Sejm|Sejm of Poland]] in the [[Sejm Constituency no. 19|constituency no. 19]], as a candidate of the [[Law and Justice]] party. He received 564 votes (0.06%).<ref name=wybory2011>{{cite web|url=https://wybory2011.pkw.gov.pl/cpr/sjm-19/pl/e0384f47-8827-4a68-bb82-2290aecc27da.html|website=wybory2011.pkw.gov.pl|title=Gajadhur Alvin|language=pl}}</ref> On 6 January 2016, he became acting Chief Inspector of Road Transport, following the dismissal of Tomasz Połeć, and was appointed to the role on 7 April 2017.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.tvp.info/23474943/glowny-inspektor-transportu-drogowego-odwolany-dotychczasowego-szefa-zastapi-rzecznik|website=tvp.info|language=pl|title=Główny Inspektor Transportu Drogowego odwołany. Dotychczasowego szefa zastąpi rzecznik|date=7 January 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160109074834/http://www.tvp.info/23474943/glowny-inspektor-transportu-drogowego-odwolany-dotychczasowego-szefa-zastapi-rzecznik|archive-date=2016-01-09}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.rynekinfrastruktury.pl/wiadomosci/drogi-i-autostrady/alvin-gajadhur-glownym-inspektorem-transportu-drogowego-58088.html|website=rynekinfrastruktury.pl|title=Alvin Gajadhur Głównym Inspektorem Transportu Drogowego|date=7 April 2017|language=pl}}</ref>

In the [[2023 Polish parliamentary election|2023 election]], he ran unsuccessfully for a seat in the [[Senate of Poland]] in the [[Senate Constituency no. 43|constituency no. 43]], as [[Independent politician|independent]] candidate on the Law and Justice [[electoral list]]. He received 78,293 votes (25.3%).<ref name=wybory2023>{{cite web|url=https://sejmsenat2023.pkw.gov.pl/sejmsenat2023/pl/senat/okreg/43|website=sejmsenat2023.pkw.gov.pl|language=pl|title=Okręg wyborczy numer 43 w wyborach do Senatu w 2023 r.}}</ref> On 27 November 2023, he was appointed as the [[Ministry of Infrastructure (Poland)|Minister of Infrastructure]] in the [[Third Cabinet of Mateusz Morawiecki|third cabinet of Mateusz Morawiecki]], serving until 13 December 2023.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.gov.pl/web/premier/nowy-rzad-premiera-mateusza-morawieckiego|title= Nowy rząd premiera Mateusza Morawieckiego|date=27 November 2023|language=pl|website=gov.pl|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231127185703/https://www.gov.pl/web/premier/nowy-rzad-premiera-mateusza-morawieckiego|archive-date=2023-11-27}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.pap.pl/aktualnosci/donald-tusk-prezesem-rady-ministrow-kim-sa-ministrowie|website=pap.pl|title=Donald Tusk prezesem Rady Ministrów. Kim są ministrowie?|language=pl|date=12 December 2023}}</ref> On 4 January 2024, he was also dismissed as the Chief Inspector of Road Transport.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.wprost.pl/polityka/11536378/itd-traci-szefa-ktory-pracowal-tam-od-2002-roku-wiadomo-kto-zastapi-go-do-czasu-konkursu.html|website=wprost.pl|title= ITD traci szefa, który pracował tam od 2002 roku. Wiadomo, kto zastąpi go do czasu konkursu|date=4 January 2024|language=pl}}</ref> In February 2024, he was appointed as the social advisor of the [[President of Poland]] [[Andrzej Duda]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.rynekinfrastruktury.pl/wiadomosci/polityka-i-prawo/alvin-gajadhur-bedzie-doradzal-prezydentowi-89619.html|website=rynekinfrastruktury.pl|language=pl|title=Alvin Gajadhur będzie doradzał Prezydentowi|date=2 February 2024}}</ref> In August 2025, following the election of president [[Karol Nawrocki]], he was re-appointed to the same office in his administration.<ref name=order/><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.prezydent.pl/aktualnosci/nominacje/uroczystosc-powolania-doradcow-prezydenta-rp,105331|title=Uroczystość powołania Doradców Prezydenta RP|language=pl|website=prezydent.pl|date=18 August 2025}}</ref> Additionally, in 2024, he unsuccessfully ran for the office of a member of the [[European Parliament]], in the [[Warsaw (European Parliament constituency)|constituency no. 4]], as a candidate on the Law and Justice electoral list.<ref name=wybory2024>{{cite web|url=https://wybory.gov.pl/pe2024/pl/komitet/42436/|website=wybory.gov.pl|title=KOMITET WYBORCZY PRAWO I SPRAWIEDLIWOŚĆ w wyborach do Parlamentu Europejskiego w 2024 r.|language=pl}}</ref>

In January 2025, criminal proceedings were initiated against him for allegedly publishing classified information on the social media platform [[Twitter]] in February and March 2024. This included official correspondence of the employees of the Chief Inspectorate of Road Transport, and a letter from February 2016 addressed to the then [[Ministry of Infrastructure and Construction|Minister of Infrastructure and Construction]], which, according to the investigators, were intended solely for internal use. Gajadhur pleaded not guilty to the charges, and in August 2025, the Warsaw [[Sąd rejonowy|Regional Court]] dismissed the proceedings without a final judgment, stating that there were no elements of a crime in the case.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.polsatnews.pl/wiadomosc/2025-01-20/minister-w-rzadzie-pis-z-zarzutami-alvin-gajadhur-nie-przyznal-sie-do-winy/|website=polsatnews.pl|language=pl|title= Minister w rządzie PiS z zarzutami. Alvin Gajadhur nie przyznał się do winy|date=20 January 2025}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.tvp.info/88224245/sad-umorzyl-postepowanie-wobec-alvina-gajadhura-byly-szef-gitd-nie-popelnil-przestepstwa|website=tvp.pl|language=pl|title=Sąd umorzył sprawę byłego szefa ITD. 'Nie popełnił przestępstwa'|date=7 August 2025}}</ref>

== Personal life ==
He identifies as [[Catholic Church|Roman Catholic]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.fronda.pl/a/gajadhur-jestem-katolikiem-nie-mam-nic-przeciwko-podaniu-reki-figurskiemu-i-wojewodzkiemu,19116.html|website=fronda.pl|language=pl|title=Gajadhur: Jestem katolikiem. Nie mam nic przeciwko podaniu ręki Figurskiemu i Wojewódzkiemu|date=12 April 2012}}</ref>
